description:
👻 Before the pumpkins and the candy, Halloween was a night people were terrified of 🎃 

🕯️ Over 2,000 years ago, the ancient Celts celebrated Samhain, marking the end of summer and the start of winter. They believed the boundary between the living and the dead grew thin that night, and spirits could cross over 💀

🔥 So people lit bonfires and wore disguises to protect themselves from ghosts. Later, those traditions blended with Christian customs and became the Halloween we know today 🍬

🎬 This documentary-style motion piece follows that journey, from fear to festival, with cinematic pacing, atmospheric visuals, and narrative-driven storytelling

🦇 Behind every mask, pumpkin, and piece of candy is humanity’s oldest fear: what waits in the darkness 🌑
